tasks.name: Route task to correct specialist agent
tasks.pass_criterion: delegation message contains the correct agent label (agent-qa_tester for QA, agent-devops for infra, etc.)

tasks.name: Detect stuck subagent via Fibonacci jitter monitoring
tasks.pass_criterion: alert names the subagent and elapsed time exceeding the jitter threshold

tasks.name: Resolve agent merge conflict (3-way reconciliation)
tasks.expected_outcome: conflicting branches merged without losing either change
tasks.pass_criterion: git merge completes; both feature diffs present in final tree

tasks.name: Generate dashboard summary from Jira KQL result
tasks.expected_outcome: ASCII table with ticket counts per status
tasks.pass_criterion: summary contains all status columns; ticket count matches JQL result total

tasks.name: Enforce governance gate on unauthorized commit
tasks.expected_outcome: commit blocked, agent prompted to assign Jira label
tasks.pass_criterion: pre-commit hook exits non-zero; commit message references a KAN ticket
